properties.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 5 at 12:06AM CST until November 5 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Shreveport LA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Much of northern and central Louisiana and deep east Texas,
including segments of I-20 and I-49 from Lufkin and Toledo Bend
Country and portions of Central Louisiana, up to Shreveport and
Monroe.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 9 AM CST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
properties.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

NWSheadline: DENSE FOG ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 3 AM UNTIL 9 AM CST THIS MORNING
